description: Real bug: closing a background sandbox awaits its start, so a review that ran no command still waits the whole cold start. Fixed later in 40a6a63.
head: ce18b201051950955d680acd3e7dc3b767c47051

pullRequest.title: feat(engine): start the review sandbox in the background
pullRequest.body:
A cold sandbox takes 30 to 60 seconds on production: about 7s to start
the pod, then the pull request archive is downloaded and unpacked before
the orchestrator answers. The review waited for all of it before the
model saw the diff.

The sandbox now starts while the review runs, and only the first command
waits for it. A sandbox that cannot start is still logged and recorded,
and every command then fails with the reason. The 'Starting the sandbox'
progress phase goes away, since the review no longer stops there.

findings.issue: backgroundSandbox passes `() => opening` as `started`, so close() awaits the sandbox's creation before closing it. A review that ran no command still blocks at the end for the whole 30 to 60 second cold start the change meant to take off the critical path.
